name: ccpm
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for lovaizu projects

plugins.name: rn
plugins.description: Say what you want, roughly: rn works out with you what you really want, carries the work through, has each result used by an agent that knows nothing of how it was made before you see it, and calls you back only for the plan, design, and deliverable sign-offs and the decisions that are yours. The session lives in git, so it resumes across conversations.

plugins.name: writ
plugins.description: Makes a document read as if a person wrote it for its reader, so you can hand it on without rereading it and judge it from the report alone.

plugins.name: turn
plugins.description: Hands one task of a plugin that has AI make something to its end: the work is made, used by an agent that knows nothing of the talk, and fixed where it stumbled, and the plugin decides its next move from the returned record without reading the work.
